== Misc.Misc (line 12)
| Misc(start)
# Creates a counter.
# 
# @param start the first value
  instruction
    | count := start

== Misc.twice (line 16)
| twice(a)
  jump
    | return 2 * a

== Misc.localClass (line 20)
| localClass()
  instruction
    | l := new Local()
  instruction
    | l.value := 1
! line 21: LocalClass

== Misc.sync (line 28)
| sync()
  instruction
    | count := count + 1
    # synchronized (lock)
! line 29: Synchronized

== Misc.check (line 34)
| check(a)
  instruction
    | assert a > 0 : "positive"
  instruction
    | count := a
    # Line comment before a statement
  instruction
    | count := count + 1
    # Block comment before a statement
  instruction
    | count := count - 1
    # trailing comment
